The '''Unslaked Thirst''' was a region in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] and the [[Mendacious Oasis]] were both located in the area.
